description.value:
This electronic "guard dog" resembles a squat black box the size of a toaster with a screen. Upgraded versions use holograms to resemble guard dogs, although many are customized to resemble more exotic pets, ranging from hell hounds to baby wyverns.

These speakers are tied to motion sensors that, when activated, emit the realistic sounds of an agitated barking canine. Like a real dog, the barking grows louder and more frequent the closer the subject approaches. It has the following statistics: +12 Intimidation; +15 Perception.

Assigning authorized users and establishing an electronic guard dog's territory takes 10 minutes.

Activate—Dogged Deterrence r (auditory)

Trigger The guard dog detects an unauthorized creature within its designated territory

Effect The electronic guard dog attempts an Intimidation check to [[/act demoralize]] one unauthorized creature within 30 feet, using 5 charges of the electronic guard dog's battery.
